messages:
Sam: Quick follow-up from today's PM (eviction cascade during spike). We need firm owners, ETAs, and an explicit handback plan for 4 action items. I'll sketch owners; please ack or reassign.

Tanya: Ack. Can you separate short-term vs long-term? I can take short-term mitigations.

Luis: I can own the metric/dashboard work and the postmortem metrics export (INF-4120). ETA 10 days.

Nikhil: I'll take the KV cache tuning (INF-4119). ETA 2 weeks for safe rollout + canary.

Sam: Draft RACI: 1) short mitigations R=Tanya, A=Sam, C=Nikhil, I=PM Bot. 2) KV tuning R=Nikhil, A=Sam, C=Tanya. 3) regression harness R=PM Bot, A=Sam, C=Tanya. 4) dashboard + alerts R=Luis, A=Sam, C=Nikhil.

PM Bot: Created tickets INF-4119, INF-4120, INF-4121, INF-4122 and linked to PM-2701.

Tanya: INF-4121 (short-mitigations) assigned to Tanya. ETA 3 business days. I'll post a rollback checklist and temporary threshold patch.

Nikhil: INF-4119 assigned to Nikhil. I'll add a spike design doc and canary plan; expect spike done in 7 days, rollout in 14.

Luis: INF-4120 assigned to Luis. I'll add eviction-rate, kv-hit-rate, and tail-p90 latency panels. Will include alerts when eviction rate > 0.5% for 5m.

Sam: Handoff/rotation plan for the remediation window: Week 1 primary = Tanya (mitigations), Week 2 primary = Nikhil (tuning + canary), Week 3 primary = Luis (dashboard + validation). Sam will be backup and own final acceptance. Update tickets with owner, ETA, and acceptance criteria by EOD tomorrow.

Tanya: Proposal: add a ticket-aging automation so owners get a forced check-in after 4 days. Draft automation below.

Sam: Please include it in the PM template.

```
Jira Automation:
when: issue created or updated
if: status not in (Done, Cancelled) and days since created >= 4
then: add comment "Owner check-in required: please update ETA or escalate"; add label "needs-owner-review"; ping #postmortems
```

Luis: +1 on automation. Also suggest adding label "recurring-pattern" to PM-2701 since similar spikes have occurred monthly.

Nikhil: I'll populate INF-4119 with the current perf numbers and a small repro. Tanya, ping me if you want the canary window times.

PM Bot: Reminder set: please update assigned tickets by EOD tomorrow or tag @sam for reassignments.

Sam: Thanks team. If anyone expects a delay, flag in the ticket and add a short blocker note so we can reassign quickly. :white_check_mark:
